remaining_boundaries.explanation: Raw instruction bytes, accounts, parser output, typed hash inputs, copy and LogUp sharing, and the six public spend fields must be connected to the normalized Lean trace.
Polynomial-commitment and FRI extraction, the exact Fiat-Shamir transcript argument, and every failure event still need one proved probability bound for V5.
The deployed Poseidon2 functions and framing must equal the Lean functions for all inputs used by the relation.
The concrete Rust grinding-hash call must equal the Lean hash call used by the Tag-67 work-verifier theorem.
A complete prover and random-oracle execution that is accepted must yield a valid relation witness, including after the attacker has observed other proofs.
The security game must sample the victim target or provide uniform per-target bounds for the nullifier and combined owner-and-note commitments.
An alternative leaf or path under the victim anchor must be reduced to Merkle binding inside a complete efficient-adversary ledger game tied to the deployed code.
